purpose: Triggers an action with a single well-known icon, such as close, search or more. The required label names the action for assistive tech.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to show, from the curated set (see the Icon component for every name)

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the action, for example "Close dialog"

props.name: variant
props.description: standard is icon only with a state layer; outlined adds a 1px border; contained is filled. Defaults to standard

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour role. danger is only for destructive actions. Defaults to primary

props.name: size
props.description: Square 32 / 40 / 48px with a 20 / 20 / 24px icon. Defaults to md

props.name: pressed
props.description: Makes it a toggle and sets aria-pressed (for example show or hide password). Leave unset for a plain action

props.name: disabled
props.description: Sets aria-disabled, keeps it focusable and blocks activation

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner over the icon, sets aria-busy and blocks activation

props.name: type
props.description: HTML button type. Defaults to button

whenToUse: For a compact, universally understood action: close, search, more options, copy, delete
In toolbars, table rows and field adornments where a text button would crowd the layout
As a toggle such as show or hide password, with pressed
whenNotToUse: When the action is not obvious from the icon alone — use Button with a text label
For the main call to action of a screen — use a contained Button
For navigation to another page — use a link
antiPatterns: Leaving out the label or repeating the icon name ("close icon") instead of the action ("Close dialog")
Using an icon whose meaning is ambiguous without a tooltip or text
Placing several contained icon buttons side by side

anatomy: Square button with one decorative Icon; while loading a spinner is drawn over the hidden icon
sizes: sm `size-control-sm` (32px) and md `size-control-md` (40px) with a `size-icon-md` (20px) icon; lg `size-control-lg` (48px) with `size-icon-lg` (24px)
typography: No text; the label is the accessible name only
motion: Colour changes over `motion-duration-standard` with `motion-easing-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: label is required and becomes aria-label; describe the action, not the icon
disabled sets aria-disabled and keeps the button in the tab order
A toggle sets aria-pressed; a plain action never does
Target size at least 24x24 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8); the smallest is 32px
Focus ring must be visible and use color-interactive-focus-ring
